crime: A girl used to share two bowls of supper with {WITCH_NAME} in the reception room, just the two of them. At each meal, {WITCH_NAME} recited old slights to the girl until she had worked herself back into anger.

Today, the girl moved their bowls to side-by-side places at the communal table in the dining hall. She would no longer deliver supper in private; from now on, {WITCH_NAME} would always have a place beside her at the table. In answer, {WITCH_NAME} drove a sword through the girl's chest in the lounge. As footsteps approached, she slipped through a paper fold and into the full-sized reception room it held.

A prisoner found the girl in the lounge gripping the sword's hilt. To the prisoners, the scene looked like self-impalement. Then one prisoner followed bloody footprints across the threshold of the paper fold. Beyond it was the reception room, where {WITCH_NAME} stood with blood on her shoes. At the trial court, the prisoners used that trail to overturn their first reading: the lounge had seemed empty only because {WITCH_NAME}, the hidden assailant, had retreated into the folded room.
fields.epitaph: Belonging had a place for her; she chose exile anyway.
execution: The execution stand clamps her flat against the cutting bed of a paper guillotine, holding her in place like a sheet. Its trimming blade swings down and shears through her neck as if cutting paper. Once the cut is complete, the guillotine settles against its bed, and her body lies motionless.

magic.name: Foldaway Rooms
magic.text: With her Magic, she can fold a room into portable paper; people can still step through a fold into the full-sized room inside.
